collection.name: Name
collection.charset.tooltip: Character set of the pages to collect
collection.userAgent.tooltip: The User-Agent header. Servers may use it to detect crawlers, so use the User-Agent of a mainstream browser
collection.intervalMin.tooltip: Minimum pause between collecting two articles, to avoid fetching too frequently. Unit: seconds
collection.intervalMax.tooltip: Maximum pause between collecting two articles, to avoid fetching too frequently. Unit: seconds
collection.autoSubmit.tooltip: Yes: articles are submitted automatically as the collection's creator and appear on the public site if the channel needs no review; No: articles are saved in the collected state, stay off the public site and must be submitted manually
collection.allowDuplicate.tooltip: Whether to collect articles whose title already exists
collection.downloadImage.tooltip: Automatically download the images and attachments in the article body
collection.listUrls.tooltip: One URL per line. Use (*) as the page number placeholder, e.g. https://www.example.com/list_(*).html
collection.itemAreaPattern.tooltip: The area of one item (article), containing its title, URL, list image, etc. Set it so that fields can take data such as the list image from the list page
collection.itemUrlFilter.tooltip: Filter applied to the article URL
collection.pattern.tooltip: Without regex, use (*) for the content to capture, e.g. {'<'}a href="(*)"{'>'} captures the link URL; with regex, use a capture group, e.g. {'<'}a href="(.*)"{'>'} captures the link URL
collection.filter.tooltip: Regular expressions, one per line. Matched content is removed and capture groups are kept, e.g. {'<'}a href="/abc"{'>'}(.*){'<'}/a{'>'} removes the link tag and keeps the link text
collection.staticValue.tooltip: Use this fixed value as the data
collection.dateFormat.tooltip: Java date format, e.g. yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
collection.dataUrl.tooltip: Build a URL from the matched data and download or fetch the data from it. $1 stands for the matched data. Leave blank if not needed.
collection.error.leafChannelOnly: Only a leaf channel can be selected
